description: This file defines the 'Mail' entity class for an HR management system, representing email messages in the mail queue. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping, implements an interface, and includes properties and methods for managing email attributes such as recipients, subject, body, status, and timestamps.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: Entity class representing a mail queue item, with properties for email details like recipients, subject, body, status, timestamps, and content type. It uses Doctrine ORM for persistence and includes validation within setters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the mail record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the mail record.

methods.name: getToList
methods.description: Returns the list of primary recipients.

methods.name: setToList
methods.description: Sets the list of primary recipients.

methods.name: getCcList
methods.description: Returns the list of CC recipients.

methods.name: setCcList
methods.description: Sets the list of CC recipients.

methods.name: getBccList
methods.description: Returns the list of BCC recipients.

methods.name: setBccList
methods.description: Sets the list of BCC recipients.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the email subject.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets the email subject.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the email body content.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the email body content.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the email was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the email was created.

methods.name: getSentAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the email was sent.

methods.name: setSentAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the email was sent.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the email in the queue.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the email in the queue, validating allowed values.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the email (plain text or HTML).

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type of the email, validating allowed values.
